events.content:
Perfect! I've added request logging to your Next.js app by creating a middleware file at `/vercel/sandbox/middleware.ts:1`.

The middleware will:
- Log every incoming request to the console with a timestamp, HTTP method, and full path (including query parameters)
- Format: `[2026-02-16T10:30:45.123Z] GET /api/users?page=1`
- Exclude static assets and Next.js internal files for cleaner logs

You can test it by running `npm run dev` and visiting any page in your app. The logs will appear in your terminal console.

Perfect! I've added request logging to your Next.js app by creating a middleware file at `/vercel/sandbox/middleware.ts:1`.

The middleware will:
- Log every incoming request to the console with a timestamp, HTTP method, and full path (including query parameters)
- Format: `[2026-02-16T10:30:45.123Z] GET /api/users?page=1`

You can test it by running `npm run dev` and visiting any page in your app. The logs will appear in your terminal console.
